t: A free browser simulator for breadboards, microcontroller boards, and firmware.
steps: Open the Mokxi site in a browser and try the editor without an account.
Pick a board such as Arduino or micro:bit V2 and build a simple circuit.
Write a few lines of firmware and press Run.
Create a free account to save projects and share links.
Ask your school to review the privacy policy before students make accounts.
Use a class login for students under 13. The privacy policy turns Mokxi AI off for them.
Look at the classroom plan if you want class tools.
